in_hebrew.name: קורהבל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A beautiful name derived from the Hebrew word 'korah' meaning 'crown', and 'bel' meaning 'God'. This name signifies a crown bestowed by God or a godly crown.

in_greek.name: Κοραβέλλη
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the Greek words 'kora' meaning 'crown' and 'belle' meaning 'goddess'. This name signifies a goddess with a crown.

in_latin.name: Corabelle
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the Latin words 'corona' meaning 'crown' and 'bellus' meaning 'little' or 'beautiful'. This name signifies a little or beautiful crown.
